name: crunchy-trail
description: Crunchy Trail – a cozy 3D ASMR game for YouTube Playables, iOS and Android

scripts.build:youtube: vite build --mode youtube --outDir dist-youtube && node scripts/package-youtube.mjs
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build:native && npx cap sync
scripts.ios: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.android: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open android
